sections.title: A face is another levered bet

items.q: What does 2026 Korea stock leverage have to do with clinics?
items.a: Same move: stake **future years** on rank. Semis, crypto, SKY, a chaebol seat — or a face. [[gangnam-face]] is the badge that you paid to look like a Seoul winner.

items.q: Why is the grind 'don't fall' instead of 'get ahead'?
items.a: [[seoul-hourglass-labor-market]]: city-state tournament + chaebol hourglass. Miss the early window; SME is not a stepping stone; startup failure is a **status drop**. China still has a middle.
It sells **rank**, not a better life. Cram school and clinic. Hirsch: if everyone has the degree / the edit, it is table stakes. Then **not buying** is the loss.

items.q: Why do firms admit looks matter?
items.a: Survey he cites (372 firms, 2020): **55.6%** say looks affect hiring. Top reason is not pretty — **55.1%** 'looks like self-management.' 2 a.m. gym is survival.

sections.title: From war repair to printer ink

items.q: How did Korea industrialize 医美?
items.a: [[medical-aesthetics-as-consumer-goods]]: war repair → 江南 consumption → toxin/laser **devices + cartridges** → Hallyu definition rights. Same playbook as cars and chips. Clinic KPI = machines, ticket, return rate.

items.q: Why fly to Seoul instead of Thailand or Brazil?
items.a: Price helps (gold microneedling he quotes cheaper than China). The ad is **Hallyu**: drama / K-pop already defined the face. Government visa lists and tax refunds are logistics. Fast is **time, not risk**.

items.q: What is the side effect of making 医美 feel like skincare?
items.a: Frequency needs **new defects**. Jane Chung wanted a nose tweak and left with chin, eyes, jaw. Ghost surgery (2016 contour death) is the brutal end. Aging gets sold as a problem.
**想变好看 ≠ 必须变好看.** Train, skincare, clothes for you and the people you love. A healthy society does not demand everyone stay young and polished.
